commits.message: chore: Update Next.js to 15.5.12 and delete pnpm-lock.yaml.
Remove main.py file containing the Hybrid Thermal Printer application code, including Flask routes, printer detection, and HTML processing functionalities.

Enhance styling and layout in POS System and Purchase Order Module

- Increased padding, font sizes, and line heights in POS System for improved readability.
- Adjusted table margins and font sizes in POS System to maintain consistency.
- Updated signature styles in POS System for better visual hierarchy.
- Added mobile order summary functionality in Purchase Order Module with responsive design.
- Implemented screen size detection for mobile view in Purchase Order Module.
- Refactored supplier selection and order summary components for better user experience.
- Improved button styles and added badges for item counts in Purchase Order Module.

Refactor Purchase Order Module and enhance printing functionality

- Removed unnecessary comments and cleaned up code in purchase-order-module.tsx.
- Improved the printPurchaseOrder and printThermalPurchaseOrder functions to utilize the poRef for printing content.
- Updated the print styles for better formatting of purchase orders.
- Changed placeholder text from "Search suppliers..." to "Search customers..." for clarity.
- Updated the badge text from "Supplier" to "Customer" for cash purchases.
- Added react-to-print library to package dependencies for enhanced printing capabilities.

Implement Hybrid Thermal Printer Utility with Flask

- Added HybridThermalPrinter class for managing thermal printing across different platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).
- Integrated HTML to text conversion for 79mm thermal printers with improved formatting for tables and other HTML elements.
- Implemented browser printing with auto-print functionality and direct printing methods.
- Enhanced CORS support for API endpoints.
- Created API endpoints for health check, printer detection, and document printing.
- Added error handling and logging for better debugging.
- Included a sample receipt page for testing print functionality.
- Implemented cleanup of temporary files on exit.
